name: Kobayashi ga Kawai sugite Tsurai!! Game demo Kyun Moe MAX ga Tomaranai~
original_name: 小林が可愛すぎてツライっ!!ゲームでもキュン萌えMAXが止まらないっ(*´ェ`*)
source:
Based on Kobayashi ga Kawai sugite Tsurai!!, which is a shoujo manga by Ikeyamada Gou. The game has an exclusive scenario unseen in the manga, and was constructed by Ikeyamada herself.

Megumu gains a new love interest in the game-exclusive character, Elio Falcone, a beautiful Italian boy. As a result, Elio and Sanada Aoi- (Megumu's original love interest) will be rivals and the plot will largely revolve around how this will affect Megumu and Aoi's relationship. There will also be Halloween, Christmas and Valentine's Day-centric subplots.
translation:
改编自池山田刚创作的少女漫画《小林可爱到不行！！》。游戏包含漫画中未出现的独家剧情，由池山田亲自构思。

惠梦在游戏原创角色、漂亮的意大利男孩埃利奥·法尔科内身上找到了新的恋爱对象。因此，埃利奥与真田葵（惠梦原本的恋爱对象）将成为竞争对手，剧情主要围绕这件事如何影响惠梦与葵的关系展开。游戏还包含万圣节、圣诞节和情人节相关支线。
